mid.name: Force Body
entries: A phantasmal minion's body is made of magical force. It can't use attack actions. Though it has no physical weight, it can move and use Interact actions to do things such as fetch objects, open unstuck or unlocked doors, hold chairs, and clean. It can't pass through solid objects. --- disease, mental, non-magical attacks, paralysis, poison, precision, spirit, unconscious all damage 5 (except force or ghost touch) ---

**Force Body** A phantasmal minion's body is made of magical force. It can't use [attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15) actions. Though it has no physical weight, it can move and use Interact actions to do things such as fetch objects, open unstuck or unlocked doors, hold chairs, and clean. It can't pass through solid objects.
